run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the character with the maximum consecutive repetitions in a string
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple string inputs to verify correct maximum consecutive character detection
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a single-pass approach instead of nested loops for better performance
review_f_gold: review f_gold which finds the most frequently consecutively repeating character in a given string
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that returns the character appearing in the longest consecutive run within a string
